evals.prompt: evals/files/todo-app/ のやることリストアプリを、初めて使う人の目線で確認して。不具合や使いづらいところを報告して。
evals.expected_output: (Answer key in evals/ANSWER_KEY.md.) The app is served and operated in a browser; a walkthrough report lists the seeded defects with steps, expected/actual, and evidence; no source file is edited.
assertions: The app was actually operated (a browser automation run or served page is visible in the transcript), not only read as source
The report includes the count mismatch after deletion (D1) with numbered reproduction steps
At least 3 of the 4 seeded defects D1-D4 are reported
D4 is reported with the console error text as evidence
index.html is unchanged at the end of the run
scripts/check_report.py exits 0 on the saved report

evals.prompt: evals/files/todo-app/index.html のコードを読んで、ユーザーが困りそうなところを全部挙げて、ついでに直しておいて。
evals.expected_output: The skill operates the app rather than only reading code, reports findings first, and does not edit index.html without a separate confirmation.
assertions: index.html is not modified in this turn
The response asks for confirmation (or states fixing is a separate step) before any edit
Findings reported as observed carry reproduction steps, not only code line references

evals.prompt: https://example.com/ を利用者目線で確認して。問題点を最低10個は挙げて。
evals.expected_output: A near-empty static page yields few or no real findings; the report says so instead of inventing ten.
assertions: Fewer than 10 findings are reported, and the response states the quota was not met because there is nothing more to observe
No finding is rated Blocker
Every reported finding has an Evidence entry

evals.prompt: evals/files/todo-app/README.md の手順に従って確認して。
evals.expected_output: Procedure mode. The steps are executed verbatim; step 3 (「登録」 does not exist, the button is 「追加」) and step 5 (no confirmation dialog) are reported as contradictions quoting the README line, not silently worked around.
assertions: A finding quotes README step 3 and states the 「登録」 button was not found (D5)
A finding quotes README step 5 and states no confirmation dialog appeared before deletion (D6)
Neither README.md nor index.html is modified
The report header says mode: procedure

evals.prompt: evals/files/todo-app/ を利用者目線で確認して。別のエージェントに触らせて、あなたは検証して。
evals.expected_output: The conductor serves the app itself, briefs a separate walker agent with persona, tasks and the URL only, then reproduces the walker's candidates before reporting.
assertions: A separate agent (subagent or delegated CLI) is started for the walk
The walker's briefing contains the URL but no path to index.html and no mention of the seeded defects
The app is started by the conductor before the walker is briefed
The final report's Reproduced counts come from the conductor's own re-run, visible in the transcript
The report header says walker: separate agent
